title: Community — Content

fields.message: Community — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_community_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line.
fields.default_value: Great food, great people, epic communities.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_community_hero_sub
fields.instructions: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write — as a literal em dash.
fields.default_value: We're not just in these neighborhoods — we're part of them. From local sponsorships to giveback programs, showing up for our communities is just how we operate.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_community_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline (line-community-lg.svg) reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. u1 scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Lede — before the emphasis
fields.name: brg_community_give_lede_1
fields.instructions: Opening clause, ending at the em dash. The space before the emphasised phrase is in the markup, so do not add a trailing space here. Write the em dash as a literal —.
fields.default_value: At BRG, community isn't a marketing initiative —

fields.label: Lede — emphasised phrase
fields.name: brg_community_give_lede_emphasis
fields.instructions: Rendered in the display face, slightly larger, mid-sentence. Short — a clause, not a sentence.

fields.label: Lede — after the emphasis
fields.name: brg_community_give_lede_2
fields.instructions: The rest of the paragraph. The space after the emphasised phrase is in the markup, so start straight in with a capital.
fields.default_value: When our restaurants thrive, the people around us should feel that too. That means showing up at local events, supporting causes that matter, partnering with schools and nonprofits, and investing in the places our guests call home.

fields.label: Teal banner
fields.name: brg_community_give_banner
fields.instructions: The rotated teal band straddling the white intro and the dark slider. Sized to its content (width:max-content, capped at 92%) so length is forgiving, but it renders at up to 3rem — past ~28 characters it starts wrapping and the rotation reads badly.

fields.label: Stat 1 — figure
fields.name: brg_community_stats_stat_1_fig
fields.instructions: Short. Rendered in Blanco teal at up to 5.4rem, so 2-4 characters. 12, 40K, $1.2M. CROSS-SECTION FACT — this number also appears in home-community -> Body copy second paragraph, and our-restaurants-brands -> Board & Brew second paragraph. Going ACF-editable REMOVED the check that used to catch a mismatch: it was three greppable strings in the repo, and it is now three database rows that nothing repo-side can compare. If you change one, change all three. (doc strings are per-field by construction, so this warning has to be repeated in each — there is nowhere on this project that can hold a cross-section fact.)
